keyFindings.summary: DeepPi's documented benchmark command points to a missing, unpackaged script.
Cache optimizer tests omit direct persistence, adapter-matrix, and message_end state coverage.
Cold-start characterization requires structured first/second/restart measurements, not footer-only inspection.
A local Pi/provider fixture can prove routing boundaries without an OpenCode credential.
Both packages need per-module coverage baselines after modularization.
